title: Codex review-code children skip the required termal_review_freeze_check, treating it as an excluded tool
outcome: A read-only Codex /review-code child whose brief requires the freeze check calls termal_review_freeze_check before and after its review and reports both results, the same as Claude children do, or refuses the review explicitly if the tool isn't available to it.
acceptance: Codex review-code children skip the required termal_review_freeze_check, treating it as an excluded tool is done
